## 裁决:**方案 2 —— 镜像开源半边,不搬文件**(维护者 2026-09-02,逐字:「ok」,对本席「推荐方案 2」的答复)

项目总监席 · session `session_01WXyGTWPbbreqXow7Z2pZCk`。裁决记录四件同笔:鲜度(卡上无晚于正文的修正)· 状态转移 · 无 `Blocked-by:` 活性问题 · 条件已判。

### 定下的规矩(一句,进 AGENTS.md 由 skills 席落编)

> 决策住在它治理的代码所在的仓。划开闭源边界与商业的决策住 cloud,本仓引用一律 `cloud ADR-NNNN`(⛔ 永不裸号);凡 cloud 决策的机制半边治理本仓开源代码的,本仓自有 ADR(自有编号 + `Provenance` 段指回 cloud 记录与日期,商业半边留 cloud),cloud 记录加一行指针;⛔ 不搬文件、不重编号。

### 执行(三步,子卡见下)

1. **规矩落编** —— AGENTS.md 一段(skills 席,受管面,draft-only + 人合)。
2. **三份镜像 ADR** —— cloud 0024 身份架构开源半边 · cloud 0071 env-side SCIM 机制 · cloud 0081 组织管理开源基础;每份一张卡,`docs/adr/**` 受管 ⇒ draft-only + 人合;形状照 `docs/adr/0079-record-display-name.md` 的 Provenance 段;落地后由接受该 PR 的席位在 cloud 仓立「加指针」杂事卡(编号那时才知道)。
3. **一次改指** —— #14361 扩到身份面整类(0071 + 0024 + 0081),(b) 类裸引用改指本仓新号,(a) 类保持 `cloud ADR-NNNN`,逐处按语义读;`Blocked-by:` 三份镜像卡。

### 状态转移(同笔)

本卡 `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`,作父单/协调节点(⛔ 永不派发),四张 sub-issue 自动成为候选;`domain:*` 归分诊。#14361 的 `Blocked-by:` 改指三份镜像卡。

**分诊路由(本评论来自分诊座位)· R+150 · 2026-09-04T19:12Z 起本批**

本卡与四张 sub-issue 一并定级。⛔ 未改本卡状态:项目总监席 2026-09-02 的裁决评论 `5507556468` 已明写「本卡 `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`,作父单/协调节点(⛔ 永不派发)」——本席照该裁决保留 `pm:queue`,只补 `domain:*` 与优先级。

| 卡 | 域 | 落点(实测,⛔ 非按标题猜) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #14496(父) | `domain:services` | 协调节点本身无代码落点;四张子卡里三张的落点在 services 车道 ⇒ 让父单对该车道可见 |
| #14506 | `domain:services` | 卡面自陈实现锚 `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/**` + `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/{sys-sso-provider,sys-user}.object.ts` |
| #14507 | `domain:services` | 同上;`git grep -li scim -- packages/plugins` 实测 **plugin-auth 31 命中**,其余仓位 ≤2;SCIM 源文件 `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-connection-service.ts` 等 |
| #14508 | `domain:services` | D1 邀请走 better-auth invitations:`git grep -rln invitation` 实测 **plugin-auth 50 命中** vs platform-objects 7;D3 渲染半边在 objectui,按卡面只引用不书写 |
| #14509 | `domain:skills` | 落点是 `AGENTS.md` —— 车道表把 `AGENTS.md` 明列在 skills 车道 |

**为什么三份镜像 ADR 同归一个车道(而不是按各自主题散开)**:它们的交付物是 `docs/adr/**` 里的散文,不落在任何包里 ⇒ 锚定规则的「落点包」判据在此不适用,替代判据是**谁能把它写对**。三份镜像陈述的机制半边都由 `plugin-auth` 执行,且 Provenance 体例要跨三份一致 ⇒ 一个车道写三份。

**优先级 p2(四张子卡与父单同)**:#14496 正文实测的缺陷是**公开仓**里 110+ 处裸引用指向无关的本地 ADR 记录(0024 ×71 / 0071 ×36 / 0081 ≥3),外部读者与 agent 顺着编号读到的是错的记录;但没有运行期错误行为 ⇒ 不是 p1。⛔ 未提级为 p1 的判据写在这里,免得下一轮重问。

⚠️ **给接手 #14508 的席位**:该卡 2026-09-04T06:11Z 有一条晚于正文的指针评论(`5536478826`),把 ADR-0131(已合)加进交叉核对表,并要求 D4 不自行判定 `sys_member` 是否保留列(引 C6 普查 #15207)。⛔ 只读正文会漏掉它。

⛔ 本席不认领、不派发、不代裁。

## Closing this coordination node — its whole tree has landed

`domain:services` execution seat, read at **2026-09-11T17:30Z**, `origin/main` @ `b863020d6`.

This card was converted by the director seat's ruling `5507556468` into a parent / coordination node, in its own words — 「本卡 `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`,作父单/协调节点(⛔ **永不派发**)」. A `pm:queue` card that may never be dispatched surfaces as a dispatch candidate every round and costs a full read each time, so it owes an explicit transition rather than a tenth day in the queue. Measured state says that transition is `closed / completed`.

### What was measured

**All four sub-issues are `closed` / `completed`:**

| sub-issue | lane | ruling step |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #14506 — ADR mirror of cloud ADR-0024 | `domain:services` | step 2 |
| #14507 — ADR mirror of cloud ADR-0071 | `domain:services` | step 2 |
| #14508 — ADR mirror of cloud ADR-0081 | `domain:services` | step 2 |
| #14509 — AGENTS.md records the registry rule | `domain:skills` | step 1 |

None carries `pm:*` residue.

**Step 3 (the single re-pointing pass) is released and owned elsewhere.** #14361 is `open` · `pm:queue` · `domain:devx` · unassigned, released on **2026-09-09T01:54Z** by comment `5594577301`, which names the landed targets the ruling was waiting on — **ADR-0135** ↔ cloud 0024 (PR #16478), **ADR-0134** ↔ cloud 0071 (PR #16476), **ADR-0133** ↔ cloud 0081 (PR #16267) — and carries the ruling's fences forward (read each citation for meaning; ⛔ the 6 CHANGELOGs and 2 changesets untouched; `auth-config.mdx` regenerated from producer strings; report the actual touched count, not "39"). ⇒ Nothing is coordinated through this parent any more: step 3 waits on the devx seat's queue, not on this card.

### ⚠️ One residual the ruling assigned that this seat CANNOT verify

The ruling's step 2 ends with a cross-repo chore, verbatim:

> 落地后由接受该 PR 的席位在 cloud 仓立「加指针」杂事卡(编号那时才知道)。

⛔ **`objectstack-ai/cloud` is outside this session's repository scope**, so whether that chore was filed after #16478 / #16476 / #16267 merged is **NOT MEASURED** — not "done", and not "missing". It is recorded here rather than carried silently through a close, because a chore whose only record is a closed card is a chore nobody reads.

⇒ Whoever holds a cloud-reachable seat: the obligation is one pointer line on each of cloud `docs/adr/0024`, `0071`, `0081` naming this repo's ADR-0135 / ADR-0134 / ADR-0133. If it is already filed there, nothing is owed and this note is the confirmation trail. If it is not, file it in `cloud` — ⛔ not here; this repo cannot hold that card.

### Transition

`pm:queue` removed in the same write as the close; `documentation` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` unchanged (⛔ an execution seat does not touch `domain:*`). `state_reason: completed` — the work was done, not abandoned. **Reopening is free** and the maintainer may override this close; the one fact that would justify reopening is the cloud pointer chore turning out to be unfiled AND someone deciding it should be tracked from this side.
